arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Cooper argued the state ban is preempted by federal law.
Mr. Heytens argued the case involves obstacle preemption, not field preemption.
General Francisco argued Virginia can ban mining for safety reasons.
Justice Gorsuch questioned if mining is distinct from plant construction regulation.
